content:
Evidence from the datasheet: eight LWDM rows (λC0–λC7) each co-occur min/center/max; per-lane AOPL max 5.6 dBm and SOMA/SRS (-16.1 / -14.1) apply to every lane; module is one ER8 SKU with 400GBASE-ER8 and 53.125 Gb/s per electrical lane. Total AOPT (14.6 dBm), 400 Gb/s branding, 425 Gb/s aggregate, 400GAUI-8, and bare "ER8" are not tied to individual wavelength rows, so they are not assigned to lane modes. Eight lane modes for SOMA and eight for SRS cover all wavelength triplets and both sensitivity values.
